protocol.rng_stream: per seed, one np.random.default_rng(seed) supplies xb, qb, then perm (insertion order of B) in that order -- identical to certified_tear.py, so A, B and the queries are bit-identical to the shipped whole-rebuild run
protocol.generations: A: natural insertion order. B: same vectors inserted in order perm = rng.permutation(N); B's level-0 adjacency remapped to the shared id space (nbB_shared), as in certified_tear.py
protocol.rewrite_set: S_f = (rngS.permutation(N))[:round(f*N)] with rngS = np.random.default_rng(seed ^ 0x5EED); one independent RNG and one permutation per seed, so the S_f are nested prefixes (S_0.05 < S_0.10 < ... < S_1.0)
protocol.splice_rule: level-0 adjacency of B_f: u in S_f -> B's remapped row nbB_shared[u]; u not in S_f -> A's row nbA_l0[u]; upper levels are not part of B_f (the spliced generation is defined by its level-0 adjacency, which is also the only thing the replay walks)
protocol.E_A: A's all-level exported edge set (identical object to E_A in certified_tear.py); graph statistics are additionally reported against A's level-0-only edge set
protocol.E_Bf: {(u, v): v in u's spliced level-0 row, v >= 0} (directed)
protocol.entry_points: both the A replay and the B_f replay start from A's entry point; at f=1.0 an additional B_f replay from B's entry point is recorded (*_B_entry) to align with certified_tear.py
protocol.replay: HNSW layer-0 ef-bounded beam search over the exported (spliced) level-0 adjacency, every expanded-to-new edge recorded -- same beam as certified_tear.py
protocol.predicate: certified <=> (some B_f-walked edge outside E_A) AND (some A-walked edge outside E_Bf)
protocol.touch_S: fraction of episodes (queries) whose B_f replay visited (entry point included) at least one node of S_f; derived from the walked edges: a node is visited iff it is the entry or the head of some walked edge
protocol.recall: replay top-10 vs exact top-10 (np.argpartition on the full distance vector)
protocol.controls: f=0.0: spliced graph identical to A, certified must be exactly 0 (asserted at runtime); f=1.0 with B's entry point: must reproduce certified_tear.py (~1.0000)
protocol.ef_grid_note: full ef grid [16, 32, 64, 128] retained; runtime fit the budget, no reduction applied
